tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Reģistrējoties ONLINE un apmaksājot dalības maksu līdz ONLINE reģistrācijas beigām - 30,00 EUR

description: Noskrien Ziemu is a winter running, hiking, and Nordic walking series held in various locations across Latvia, including Ropaži Municipality. The event takes place whatever the weather, offering participants the chance to run or hike through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads. The aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and popularize running in winter, as well as support Latvia’s trail running team. Participants can expect high standards of quality and safety, and the opportunity to compete in the season standings and receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Routes run through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads
The event takes place whatever the weather—ice, snow, rain, or frost
Start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 to 10:50. The start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre (Sporta iela 2-k-1, Ropaži). After the event, participants receive a 10% discount at Ozolgravas café (Rīgas iela 4, Ropaži) upon showing their race number. Participant limit: 800. Departure from Riga at 8:30, arrival in Ropaži at around 9:30, return trip at 15:30 after the awards ceremony. It is strictly forbidden to enter the event centre indoors wearing shoes with spikes or dirty shoes.

name: Skriešanas seriāls “Ugāle”, III posms
description: The “Ugāle” running series is a running event organized by the Ventspils Municipality Sports School, bringing together runners of different ages and ability levels. The series’ third stage will take place in Ugāle, giving participants the opportunity to compete and improve their results. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized to a high professional standard, providing a quality competition environment.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 2. posms Koknesē
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 2 in Koknese is a winter running event offering the opportunity to take part in various distances and sports. The event is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes and active people who want to test their abilities in winter conditions. The race takes place in Koknese, offering a challenge and enjoyment for both individual runners and teams. Registration is open, but participant numbers are limited, so it is also possible to join the waiting list.
additional: Participant numbers are limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on the waiting list. Registration is available only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage at a time. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and place of residence for statistics.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 3. tumsas posms Smiltenē
description: Noskrien Ziemu 3rd Night Stage in Smiltene is a winter running race that gives participants the opportunity to test their abilities in wintry and challenging conditions. The race takes place in Smiltene and is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes from different places. The event is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs, offering various distances and the opportunity to take part in a hike. The organizers provide a convenient registration process and support for participants.
additional: Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 4. posms
additional: The participant limit has been reached. If an application is submitted after the limit is reached, it will be placed on the waiting list. Registration is possible only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 5. posms Liepājā
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 5 in Liepāja is part of the popular Noskrien Ziemu running race series held during Latvia’s winter season. The race gives athletes and active recreation enthusiasts the opportunity to test their abilities over various distances while enjoying the scenery of Liepāja and its surroundings. The event welcomes both professional runners and amateurs, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit. Registration is open, but the number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the city of Liepāja and its surroundings
A variety of distance options for both runners and hiking participants
Stage 5 of the winter running race series
additional: The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list. Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and municipality of residence.

name: Pagalma superskrējiens

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dalība “Pagalma superskrējienā” ir minimālais ziedojums 30 eiro apmērā Latvijas Bērnu atbalsta fondam (LBAF).

description: The Backyard Super Run is a unique running event that brings together endurance, community spirit, and charity. Participants must complete a 6.7 km run every hour, and each person chooses how many runs to do—from one to twelve—for a maximum distance of 80.4 km in a day. The event takes place in Teika. The first start is at 10:00, with subsequent starts every hour. After finishing, participants receive a special sports shirt featuring superheroes drawn by Latvian children, and all proceeds are donated to the Latvian Children's Support Foundation.
course_highlights: Complete a 6.7 km run every hour
Participants can do 1 to 12 runs, covering up to 80.4 km in a day
The first start is at 10:00, with subsequent starts every hour
additional: Registration on the day of the event opens at 8:30. Participants who complete one run become Sprīdītis, while those who complete all 12 runs earn the title of Lāčplēsis. The sports shirts are provided by Mizuno in cooperation with Sporta punkts.

name: Skrējiens “Rozentālam pa pēdām”
description: The “In the Footsteps of Rozentāls” run is a trail run held in Saldus and dedicated to local artist Janis Rozentāls. The event brings runners together to enjoy running and pay tribute to the artist. The run has become a traditional event with a friendly atmosphere and beautiful scenery in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Saldus area
Run dedicated to artist Janis Rozentāls
Traditional event with a friendly atmosphere

description: The “Latvijas valsts mežu Stirnu buks” trail running series is a popular trail running event held on some of Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The races are friendly and encourage people to enjoy nature as well as the spirit of athletic competition. The series takes place in various regions of Latvia, and on March 27, 2027, a race will be held in Tērvete. Participants can choose from several distances, from routes for children and young people to longer, more technical courses for adults.
course_highlights: Trails with varied surfaces—pavement, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road
Scenic forest trails in Latvia, surrounded by natural beauty
Separate distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Online registration closes at 12:00 on the Thursday before race week. Late registration is available at the race center on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start before the runners; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Participants can purchase a discounted season pass. Discounts apply to some distances for juniors, seniors and special groups. Participant profiles can be created using a social media account or email.

name: Apkārt Māras dīķim 12 h un stafete 6h
organizer: Šri Činmoja Maratona komanda; biedrība “Rīgas Šri Činmoja centrs”
description: The “Pārspēj sevi” (Surpass Yourself) run is a 12-hour individual race and a 6-hour relay held on a loop around Māras Pond in Riga. The event is intended for both amateur and professional runners. Its main goal is to help participants discover and push beyond their abilities with a positive attitude and determination. The loop is 1.355 km long, and the spirit of the race is based on perseverance and enjoyment rather than winning. Participants are encouraged to take part with a smile and keep going as they overcome both internal and external challenges during prolonged exertion.
course_highlights: Certified 1.355 km loop around Māras Pond
Choose between the 12-hour individual race and the 6-hour relay
Relay team members may change an unlimited number of times, but only after a full lap in the start/finish area
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race morning from 6:00 to 6:45 for the 12-hour race and from 12:00 to 12:45 for the 6-hour relay. Pacing is prohibited, and any assistance is allowed only in the start/finish area and in the approximately 100-metre section beyond it. The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. In the relay, team members may change after a full lap in the start/finish area.

name: 6/12 stundu skrējiens “Pārspēj sevi”
organizer: Šrī Činmoja Maratona komanda; Biedrība “Rīgas Šrī Činmoja centrs”
description: The 6- and 12-hour “Beat Your Own Best” run takes place around Māras Pond in Riga, giving participants the opportunity to push their limits and experience personal growth. The certified course is 1,355 km long, allowing runners to focus on sustained endurance and pace. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has served the running community for almost 50 years, inspiring athletes to develop physically and spiritually. Registration is by email, and the entry fee depends on the payment date. Race numbers are provided to participants on race day.
course_highlights: A certified 1,355 km course around Māras Pond
An endurance run with 6- and 12-hour events
An event with almost 50 years of tradition and spiritual inspiration
additional: The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Race numbers are issued on race day. To register, email the required information. No refunds are given if a participant does not take part.

name: Skrējiens un soļošana pa Preiļu ielām “Cīruļputenis”
organizer: Preiļu novada Bērnu un jauniešu sporta skola
description: The “Cīruļputenis” run and walk through the streets of Preiļi is a traditional spring running and walking event in the city, bringing together athletes and active residents of all ages. Held on the city streets, the event offers a chance to enjoy running and walking in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The competition is organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School, which provides professional support and a safe environment for participants. It is a great opportunity for both beginners and experienced athletes to test their abilities and enjoy an active day with fellow sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Running and walking through the streets of Preiļi
A friendly, sporting atmosphere for all age groups
Organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School
additional: In previous years, the competition has started outside Preiļi Municipality Council or on Raiņa Boulevard.

name: Siguldas apļi
organizer: Biedrība “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” sadarbībā ar Siguldas novada pašvaldību

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: OPEN, SV30 – SV50+ dalības maksa 5.00 eur

description: Sigulda Circuits is a series of running and Nordic walking training races in Sigulda, held in several stages at different locations around the city. The aim of the races is to promote an active lifestyle, encourage meaningful ways to spend free time, and bring together friends and like-minded people. The series offers opportunities for schoolchildren, families, and individual runners, with a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere. The races are organized by the association “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” in cooperation with Sigulda Municipality.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes at various locations around Sigulda
Stages take place at Festivity Square, near the Sigulda bobsleigh track, and in Gutman’s Cave
Nature trails and urban scenery in Sigulda Municipality
additional: Participant timing chips are issued from 17:30. Participants with an S! Card receive a 20% discount on the entry fee. Use of the electronic timing system equipment is free of charge. Participants can look forward to pleasant surprises and prizes at the end of the series.

name: BYU Lūša pēdās Jēkabpilī
description: BYU In the Footsteps of the Lynx in Jēkabpils is a unique running event where participants compete by running a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains. The race is physically and mentally challenging, attracting both local and international runners. The event is well organized, with precise timing and a friendly atmosphere that fosters sportsmanship and a sense of community. The participant list reflects a broad range of runners from Latvia and neighboring countries.
course_highlights: Run a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains
The race takes place in Jēkabpils, with precise timing using RFID equipment
The event attracts both local and international participants
additional: Timing with RFID equipment ensures accurate recording of results. The participant list is available online, and registration takes place online. The race is part of a wider range of events organized by RaceTiming.LV.

name: Aizkraukles novada 12. pusmaratons
description: The 12th Aizkraukle Municipality Half Marathon is a traditional running event offering a half-marathon distance and a popular run. The race takes place in Aizkraukle and brings together runners of all levels, with children’s races also on offer. The event is suitable for athletes and families looking to spend time actively outdoors and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.097 km
Popular run: 5.3 km with a slight elevation gain (300 m)
Children’s races: 500 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event offers a variety of races, including children’s distances, making it suitable for families. Registration takes place online at sportlat.lv, where participants can create a profile and access personalized options.

name: Rudes Maratons un Kultūras festivāls
location: Rude, Rojas pagasts, Talsi Municipality, Latvia
description: The Rudes Marathon and Culture Festival offers a running route around Rude that is relatively flat and approximately 1.8 km long. This loop follows roads, providing an easy and accessible distance for both beginners and experienced runners. The event combines sporting activities with the atmosphere of a cultural festival, creating a friendly, community-focused environment.
course_highlights: Relatively flat loop
The route follows roads
Approximately 1.8 km long
additional: The route profile and elevation data are available for download. The route is also suitable for hiking and is easy to access using various route-planning and navigation options with plotaroute.com tools.

description: Pilsēttakas Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s scenic forest trails. This event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels, encouraging an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature. The race welcomes both beginners and experienced trail runners, with particular attention given to youth and children’s categories. The event is well organized and offers the option to participate individually or in teams, as well as season passes.
course_highlights: Routes with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, forest firebreaks and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for various age groups and fitness levels
Late registration and participation in a non-timed walk are available on race day
additional: Late registration is available at the race center on race day, up to 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; walking participants may set out on the course from 9:00 to 10:30 without timekeeping. Walkers should note that after 12:00 they may encounter fast runners on the courses. Season passes are available at a discount, but an additional fee applies if the “Vilks” distance is selected on 20 June.

name: Ropažu novada RETRO skriešanas svētki
location: Vecā Kangaru stacija, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: The Ropaži Municipality Retro Running Festival is an annual sporting event held on 1 May near Kangari Station. The festival invites everyone to take part and spend the holiday actively, enjoying running and a sense of community. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a sporting atmosphere in the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Old Kangari Station
Various distance options for all age groups
A friendly, festive atmosphere with a retro theme
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 14:30, offering a range of activities and opportunities for all participants. No registration fees or direct registration links are listed. The organizers encourage people to follow updates on the municipality’s website.

name: Skrējiensoļojums Rīga-Valmiera
description: The Rīga–Valmiera ultramarathon is an epic 107 km charity trail-running race held every year in early May. The race starts in Rīga and follows a route to Valmiera, offering participants a challenge and an opportunity to push their limits. The race has become a tradition, bringing together professional trail runners and enthusiasts, and is closely connected to Latvia’s national history and sporting community. The event also provides significant support to the Latvian trail-running team and serves as a platform for charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: A 107 km trail from Rīga to Valmiera
A route known for record-setting and challenges for trail runners
Starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, with a precise course record time
additional: The race starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, and the precise course record time is 7:30:49. The race is charitable in nature and supports the Latvian trail-running team. Participant numbers are record-breaking, and the route is known for its challenges and record-setting.

name: Ritma skrējiens Liepājā
description: “Ritma skrējiens” in Liepāja invites everyone to run at their own pace—fast or slow, with a smile or in a competitive spirit. The event brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels, offering several distances, including children’s races. The race starts at Daugava Stadium, and the atmosphere is complemented by music, positive energy, and the joy of being together.
course_highlights: The start is at Daugava Stadium in Liepāja.
The course passes through Liepāja’s cityscapes and surrounding area.
Previous event descriptions mention distances ranging from children’s races to 21 km.
additional: The event’s motto invites runners to go fast or slow—the main thing is to run at your own rhythm.

name: Apkārt Cēsīm
location: Cēsu Pils parka estrāde, Cēsis, Latvia
organizer: Cēsu novada pašvaldība sadarbībā ar sporta klubu „Ašais”
description: The “Around Cēsis” run is a traditional spring running event held on the streets and in the park of Cēsis, attracting both local and international runners. The competition offers several distances—a children’s run, 5 km and 10 km—with the fastest runners recognized in different age groups and in the team classification. The courses are marked, and the 10 km course is certified, ensuring a professional standard of competition. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raise the profile of Cēsis Municipality as a centre for active living. Participants are provided with electronic timing, commemorative medals and safety along the course.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is certified and marked
A short children’s run takes place in the city park
The competition takes place on the streets of Cēsis and in the city park
additional: Race starts: children’s run at 11:00, 5 km at 11:30, 10 km at 12:15. Race numbers must be attached to the front of the sports shirt with four safety pins. Time limits: 5 km — 40 minutes; 10 km — 1 hour 30 minutes. After the run, physiotherapist massages and consultations are available in a designated tent. In the 10 km team classification, each team consists of 2 men and 1 woman. Team entries must be submitted separately. The event centre is located at the Cēsis Castle Park open-air stage. The 10 km course is certified, and finishers receive a commemorative medal.

name: Jūrmalas skriešanas svētki
description: Jūrmala Running Festival is a running and Nordic walking event held on the beach at Majori, on the coast of Jūrmala, with sandy courses. The event offers distances for all ages and abilities, from a children’s race to a 21 km Nordic walking race in the sports class. Participants in the 10 km and 5 km races start alongside musician Ozols, creating a special atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, with medals and a refreshment point at the finish.
course_highlights: Sandy courses on Majori Beach
Distances for children, beginners, and experienced athletes
10 km and 5 km races alongside musician Ozols
additional: Registration and race bib collection begin at 9:00 on race day. Bibs can be collected in advance at T/c “Riga Plaza” on 2 and 3 May from 10:00 to 19:00. The entry fee includes a race bib with a timing chip, a refreshment point at the finish, and a medal for finishers within the time limit. System service fee: EUR 1.21.

name: Latvijas čempionāts jūdzes 1609m skrējienā
description: The Latvian 1609 m Mile Running Championship is a prestigious running event that brings together Latvia’s best runners. The competition takes place in Līvāni and offers the chance to compete over a short, intense distance that demands speed and endurance. The event is part of Latvia’s sporting calendar and promotes the development of the country’s running tradition.
course_highlights: The distance is exactly 1609 metres, or one mile
The competition takes place within the city of Līvāni
A fast, intense race offering a chance to test your speed

name: Backyard Race
description: Backyard Race is an obstacle course race in Ozolnieki, offering a short course with world-class obstacles. The race is suitable for both experienced athletes and those who want to try OCR (Obstacle Course Racing) in a short format. It is a dynamic and challenging event that brings together active participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A short course with world-class obstacles
The race takes place in Ozolnieki
Short-distance OCR race
additional: This short-distance OCR race takes place in Ozolnieki and offers world-class obstacles over a few kilometers.

name: Wings for Life World Run (Valmiera)
organizer: Wings for Life World Run Valmierā organizatori
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world. There is no traditional finish line—participants run as far as they can until they are caught by a special “Catcher Car.” The event is open to runners, wheelchair users, and beginners, and 100% of entry fees are donated to spinal cord research. The race in Valmiera will take place at J. Daliņš Stadium and is part of this global event, bringing people together around the world to support those who cannot run themselves.
course_highlights: Starts simultaneously around the world
There is no traditional finish line—the finish is when the Catcher Car catches you
Participants can run, roll, or walk, and everyone competes together
additional: The start is not only in Valmiera but takes place simultaneously around the world. The Catcher Car begins pursuing participants 30 minutes after the start and continues catching up with them until everyone has been caught. The event is inclusive of everyone—beginners, athletes, and wheelchair users. The official Wings for Life World Run app is required to participate.

name: Rimi Rīgas maratons
description: Rimi Riga Marathon is an annual running festival held in Riga, offering a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 6 km races, as well as relay races. The event takes place on 15 and 16 May, bringing together runners from around the world. It is part of the prestigious SuperHalfs European half marathon series and offers new, scenic and fast courses. Participants can also take part in relay races, making the longer distances more accessible to a wider audience.
course_highlights: New, scenic and fast courses in the city of Riga
Marathon relay with four legs: 10.5 km, 6.5 km, 12.5 km and 12.7 km
Half marathon relay with two legs: 10.2 km and 10.9 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Rimi Olympic Centre. The 6 km start is split into two start times, which are shown on the race bib. Relay teams can have 2 to 4 runners, and one runner may complete multiple legs. Registration details can be changed free of charge until 30 April 2027, including year of birth, email address, phone number, team name, nationality and country of residence.

description: The Wild Vidzeme Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which offers various distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The event takes place on scenic forest trails in Latvia, where participants can enjoy a variety of surfaces, including asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain. This race takes place in the vicinity of Augstroze and is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. Stirnu buks is a traditional, friendly event that promotes an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Trails with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
Scenic forest trails in Latvia’s Vidzeme region
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Last-minute registration is available at the event centre on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first. Hike participants may set off on any distance between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups.

name: “Mizojam, ka prieks”
location: Zeltiņu pļavas, Zeltiņi, Alūksne Municipality, Latvia
description: We run for joy is an open cross-country running series in Zeltiņi Parish, organised by Sports Club Zeltiņi since 2013. The races take place in four rounds in the meadows of Zeltiņi and are open to different age groups and fitness levels, with distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group. The event welcomes both recreational runners and experienced athletes, and is characterised by variety, accessibility and a sense of togetherness. Traditionally, warm-ups are led by Latvian Olympians and athletes, creating a special atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on trails through the meadows of Zeltiņi
Distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group
Warm-ups led by Latvian Olympians and athletes
additional: The competition is a four-round series open to children and adults, as well as walkers in the 60+ age group. Local businesses and the community support the event, promoting an active and sporty lifestyle. The series consists of four rounds, with events held at different locations in Zeltiņi Parish. The season opening includes a group warm-up run and soup by the campfire.

name: Rojas 24h, 12h, 6h un maratona skrējieni
description: Roja Marathon Festival offers a variety of distances, including 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour ultramarathons, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. The event takes place at Roja Stadium on a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. It welcomes both professional runners and amateurs, with a range of races and Nordic walking. The festival also includes children’s races and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and the spirit of competition by the sea.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1,234.7 m
Course surface: stadium and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has World Athletics certification
additional: The 24-hour ultramarathon starts at 15:00, the 12-hour race at 20:00, the 6-hour race at 09:00, and the 42 km race at 10:00. The course is a 1,234.7 m loop with stadium and asphalt surfaces. Registration and bib collection take place on race day from 12:00 to 14:00. The awards ceremony is at 17:00.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 1. posms – Uzvaras parks
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Victory Park. The series aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with distances ranging from children’s races to 10 km. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, and participants can take part individually or in family teams.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Victory Park on a 1.52 km loop
The 5 km distance consists of three loops along the park paths
The relatively flat terrain is suitable for runners of different levels
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. There are two entrances to the start area, and participants are asked to assess their pace honestly when choosing a place in the start corral. A dedicated bag storage facility is available; participants receive a tag that must be kept for the entire season, and replacing it costs 2 EUR. It is recommended to arrive at least 30–45 minutes before the start. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The series includes five events per season; participants who start in at least four events receive a commemorative season prize.

name: Vilkaču maratons
description: Vilkaču Marathon is a challenging 42-kilometer marathon along forest trails in Tukums Municipality, considered one of the toughest marathons. The course includes more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain on steep and very steep climbs, and participants must complete thirteen laps, passing the race center several times. During the race, a hydration and food station is available in the start/finish area, and the winner receives 25% of all participants’ entry fees. This marathon offers seven hours of racing in a forest, among hills and in a place steeped in legends, where participants compete against themselves and the clock.
course_highlights: 42 km along forest trails with more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain
Thirteen laps, passing the race center several times
Steep and very steep climbs on the slopes of Āžu Hill
additional: A hydration and food station, staffed by the marathon chef, is available in the start/finish area.

name: Ventspils pusmaratons
description: Ventspils Half Marathon 2027 is an annual running event taking place on June 6 in Ventspils. The race offers various distances, including a half marathon (21.0975 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a children’s run, welcoming participants of different ages. The event is organized by the Maratona Klubs Association in cooperation with the Ventspils City Council, providing professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through some of Ventspils’ most beautiful spots, offering both city scenery and seaside views.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Distances suited to different age groups, including a children’s run
The course passes through Ventspils city and seaside scenery
additional: Participants may transfer from a longer distance to a shorter one free of charge until 01.06.2027. During race week, changing distances costs 10 EUR. Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the 10 km and 5 km distances until 03.06.2027. Registration on race day is available, but full services may not be provided. Runners from Russia and Belarus are not permitted to participate.

name: Vertikālais kilometrs (VK) Siguldā
description: The Vertical Kilometer in Sigulda is a challenging mountain run that offers a chance to test your strength and endurance on the trails of Sigulda’s hills. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to climb 1,000 meters in elevation. The event is part of the Sigulda Running Series, which brings together athletes and active people from all over Latvia. The run takes place in beautiful natural surroundings, with breathtaking views and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A challenging climb with 1,000 meters of elevation gain
Run along the mountain trails in Sigulda and the surrounding area
Breathtaking views and natural scenery
additional: Race bibs and timing chips will be issued at the start venue.

name: Ezerkauliņi Salaspils pilsētas pusmaratons
description: The “Ezerkauliņi” Salaspils City Half Marathon brings together running enthusiasts, Salaspils residents and visitors for a sporting celebration in Salaspils. Participants can choose the half marathon, a 10.55 km run or Nordic walking, a 5.27 km fun run, or a 0.75 km children’s run. The course runs along Salaspils streets, and the event invites everyone to enjoy moving together and the city’s atmosphere.
course_highlights: The city course runs along the streets of Salaspils.
A 21.097 km half-marathon distance is available.
Participants can also take part in the 10.55 km distance by Nordic walking.
additional: A 0.75 km children’s run is also available.

name: 46. skrējiens "Apkārt Vaidavas ezeram"
description: The “Around Lake Vaidava” race is a traditional running event held in the Vaidava area. Participants can take part in the 11.7 km race or the walk, enjoying beautiful scenery and a well-prepared course. The event is popular and attracts many participants, offering timing and service points. Commemorative medals are provided, but their number is limited and they are allocated in order of registration. The race is suitable for both athletes and people who enjoy active recreation.
course_highlights: 11.7 km running distance around Lake Vaidava
A walk along a scenic, well-prepared course
Service points and timing chips for race participants
additional: The number of commemorative medals is limited, and they are provided to participants in order of registration: medals go to 11.7 km race participants with registration numbers up to 340 and walk participants with numbers up to 100. Participants who register after the limit has been reached will receive a full participation package without a medal.

description: Saulgriežu nakts Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which takes place on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. This leg offers a unique night trail-running experience in Liepāja, where participants can enjoy roads and trails with a variety of surfaces that wind through natural landscapes. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with several distances, including options for children and young people. The event is friendly and inspiring, fostering a sporting spirit and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Roads and trails with a variety of surfaces — asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
A night trail run with a special atmosphere and challenges
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Registration closes at 12:00 on the Thursday before race week. Late registration is available at the event centre on race day until 30 minutes before the start. Participants are awarded in different age groups and in the overall standings. The series also includes the Latvian Youth Trail Running Championships.

name: Skrējiens “Jānis un Jānītis”
organizer: Noskrien Cēsis un Cēsu novada pašvaldība
description: The “Jānis and Jānītis” run is a traditional Cēsis race with a history dating back to 1989, inviting young and old alike to take part in a festive sporting atmosphere. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle, inspire new achievements, and promote Cēsis as a city for active recreation. A range of distances is offered, from a 600-metre children’s run through the city to a 13 km course on asphalt, gravel, and forest roads. Registration is open until 17 June, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 600 m children’s run to a 13 km course
The course includes asphalt, gravel, and forest roads
The race takes place in Cēsis and its surrounding area
additional: Registration must be completed by 17 June. The distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels.

name: Līgo skrējiens Ozolos, Liezēres pag.
description: The Līgo Run in Ozoli is an annual running event held in Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality. The aim of the race is to promote running and Nordic walking as a healthy, active lifestyle, and to foster togetherness and a sporting atmosphere on Līgo Day. The course is a marked loop, offering different distances for children and adults, including a popular run and a Nordic walking distance. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, and is organized in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.
course_highlights: Loop course with a 3 km lap and a 500 m children’s lap
Various distances for children and adults, including 3 km, 6 km, and 9 km options
Course marked along its entire length
additional: The race takes place in Ozoli, Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality, in the parking lot opposite the shop. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are divided into age groups and gender categories. The organizer is the association “Madonas rings,” in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 2. posms – Mežaparks
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 2 is part of the popular Riga running series, offering running fun for the whole family in the beautiful Mežaparks area. This stage is one of five unique runs held in different locations around Riga, featuring flat and scenic courses. The event brings together professional runners and amateurs alike, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere. Traditionally, the race takes place in the evening, allowing participants to enjoy running in a city park.
course_highlights: A run through Mežaparks on flat and scenic trails
The course goes around a pond and through Māras Garden
Running in Riga’s most beautiful park areas
additional: The race traditionally starts at 18:30. The event is part of a five-stage series held in different parks and areas around Riga. Participants can take part individually or with their families. The event usually concludes with an awards ceremony and various activities.

name: Rojas pusmaratona festivāls
description: The Roja Half Marathon Festival is an annual running event held in Roja, offering a range of distances, including a 21.1 km half marathon, 12.3 km, 3 km, and children’s races. The competition takes place on a stadium track and a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. The festival welcomes both professional and amateur runners and also features a 24-hour ultramarathon and other running options. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the Zvejnieksvētki morning activities in Roja.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1234.7 m
Course surface: stadium track and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has a World Athletics certificate
additional: Registration and bib collection take place from 7:00 to 8:45 (3 km) and until 9:15 (21.1 km, 12.3 km, and 400 m children’s races). The 3 km race starts at 9:00, the 12.3 km race and Nordic walking at 9:30, the half marathon at 9:30, and the children’s races at 9:45. The festival also includes 24-hour, 12-hour, and 6-hour races with separate start times. The awards ceremony takes place at around 12:00–13:00. Individual support points for the ultramarathon are available along the course.

name: Liepājas pusmaratons (Jūras svētki)
location: Lielais Dzintars Concert Hall, Liepāja, Latvia
description: The Liepāja Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Liepāja, bringing together local and international runners. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy the city’s most beautiful spots and its proximity to the sea while completing the half-marathon distance. The event is part of Sea Festival celebrations, creating a special festive atmosphere for participants and spectators. It is a great way to combine sport with cultural activities and relaxation in Liepāja.
course_highlights: The route runs through the central streets of Liepāja
Views of the sea and the seaside promenade
Part of the Sea Festival celebrations, with a special atmosphere
additional: Finishers receive a Sea Festival commemorative medal, and participant registration includes BTA accident insurance.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 3.posms Biķernieku trase
location: Biķernieku trase, Sergeja Eizenšteina iela, Riga, Latvia
organizer: Biedrība “Piedzīvojumu sacensību apvienība” sadarbībā ar Rīgas valstspilsētas pašvaldību
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Biķernieku Track. The series offers a range of distances suitable for active runners, beginners, and children. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. Each event is specially organised with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in family and sports-team categories.
course_highlights: Biķernieku Track, with 6 laps in the 10 km distance
The races take place in Riga’s parks and neighbourhoods on flat terrain
Distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Participants may take part with strollers, but dogs are not allowed. A single registration gives participants a number that is valid for all events. Participants who take part in at least 4 of the 5 events receive a season commemorative prize. It is recommended to arrive 30–45 minutes before the start to collect your race number and warm up. The event centre is at Biķernieku Track by the stadium, on S. Eizenšteina Street. The course is marked. The venue is accessible by public transport, but parking is paid.

name: Ozolkalna VK
additional: The participation fee must be paid by bank card or bank transfer. If paying by bank transfer, registration details must be sent to latloppet@gmail.com.

name: 12. skrējiens Piltene
description: Skrējiens Piltene is an annual running event in Piltene that brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels. Previous editions have included 10 km and 5 km races, as well as shorter events and Nordic walking starts. The event aims to promote an active, healthy lifestyle and popularize running.
course_highlights: The event’s main race is a 10 km road run.
Previous editions have also included a 5 km race.
Participants have also been offered a mile race and a 5 km Nordic walking start.

name: Jelgavas nakts pusmaratons

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pusmaratona stafete sastāv no 2 dalībniekiem. Cena ir 20x2 = 40 euro €17,50 - +

description: BTA Jelgava Night Half Marathon is a night half marathon organized by the Baltic Events Association in Jelgava. Participants can compete individually in the half marathon or as a two-person relay team. The event is a popular sporting occasion that brings together runners who want to test their abilities at night in an urban setting.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 4. posms – Lucavsala
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 4 is part of a popular running series held in Riga’s parks and neighborhoods, designed for the whole family. This stage will take place on Lucavsala, giving participants the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful, green urban setting. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and for welcoming both professional and amateur runners. At the end of the event, the fastest runners and the season’s overall leaders are traditionally honored.
course_highlights: Run through Lucavsala Park and the surrounding area
Green, flat terrain suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and the chance for the whole family to compete
additional: A concert and party are traditionally held at the end of the event, adding to the sporting experience. Participants can check in until noon on race day. The series brings together around two thousand participants at each stage.

name: Gauja Trail by UTMB
distance_verbose: 91 km, 53 km, Pusmaratons, 13.5 km, 13 km, 12 km, 6 km, 1.6 km
description: Gauja Trail by UTMB offers a beautiful trail run through the Gauja Valley, combining forest trails, hills, and scenic riverbanks. The 100 km course starts at Sigulda New Castle and passes through Līgatne and Cēsis, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature and scenery of Gauja National Park. Runners should take note of the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions. The event takes place in August 2027 and is part of the UTMB World Series.
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trails and hilly terrain in the Gauja Valley
The course includes the Sigulda bobsleigh track and the sandstone cliffs of Līgatne
Finish at Rožu Square in Cēsis
additional: Participants must bring the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions, including the possibility of spending the night outdoors on the course. In hot weather, organizers may require additional fluids, a hat, and sunglasses. Registration is personal and cannot be transferred to another person or to the following year. After finishing the 100 K and 50 K distances, participants are provided with a meal and baggage transport.

name: Kuldīgas 22. pusmaratons
description: The Kuldīga Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kuldīga Municipality, bringing together local and visiting runners. The race takes place amid the scenic surroundings of the town and its nearby area, offering a chance to enjoy both a sporting challenge and beautiful natural views. The event is organized by Kuldīga Municipality Sports School, ensuring professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kazdangas pils maratons
description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail running and Nordic walking event held at the Dzirnezers recreation area in Kazdanga. The event offers marathon and half-marathon distances for both runners and Nordic walkers, giving participants the chance to experience a scenic and challenging trail route. Starts are in the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and sporting atmosphere of South Kurzeme Municipality. The event is suitable for athletes of various levels and fans of active recreation.
course_highlights: 42.195 km marathon and 21.097 km half-marathon distances
The recreation area by Dzirnezers serves as the start and finish venue
A trail route around Kazdanga amid natural scenery
additional: The marathon starts at 08:00 for Nordic walkers and 09:00 for runners. The half-marathon starts at 10:00 for Nordic walkers and 11:00 for runners. Each distance has separate starts for runners and Nordic walkers.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 5. posms – Māras dīķis
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series for the whole family, held at five unique locations in Riga and offering unforgettable runs. The 5th stage will take place by Māras Pond, where participants will run on a scenic, flat course around the pond and through Māras Garden. The event is suitable for both active runners and beginners, offering various distances and the option to take part in a health run. At the end, the fastest runners and overall season winners are traditionally celebrated, followed by a concert and party.
course_highlights: Course around Māras Pond and through Māras Garden
Flat terrain, suitable for speed and enjoyment
The run takes place in a Riga park with beautiful natural scenery
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. Staggered starts for the children's distances take place at 18:30. Only bags with a special tag, provided at registration together with the race bib, may be left at the bag drop. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The 5 km distance consists of 3 laps of a 1.52 km course.

name: Jūrmalas krāsu skrējiens
organizer: UAB GEE TEAM sadarbībā ar Baltijasmaratoni.lv
description: The Jūrmala Color Run is a joyful and positive 5 km run held in Kauguri Park in Jūrmala. The event aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle by inspiring participants to take part in sports activities. The run is suitable for all fitness levels and ages, and is part of the global The Color Run™ movement, which creates happiness through sport. Both adults and children take part, and it is known as one of the happiest 5 km runs in the world.
course_highlights: 5 km distance in Kauguri Park with color challenges
Suitable for all fitness levels and ages
Part of the global The Color Run™ movement
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue from 10:30 until 30 minutes before the start of each distance. A limited number of THE COLOR RUN™ souvenir shirts and extra color packets are available at the event. The children's distance is approximately 500 meters. There is no timekeeping; participants can complete the distance at their own pace.

name: Taurlandia Taurkalnē

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dalības maksa 15 EUR. Pieteikšanās no 17.08.2027, kad noslēgusies 50K pieteikšanās

description: Taurlandia is an ultrarun in the Taurkalne area, offering a scenic 50 km distance along a trail steeped in legend. The race is part of the events organized by SK Mitauer, which promotes running and an active lifestyle in Latvia. Participants receive a healthy meal after the finish, aid stations along the course, and commemorative medals. The course is registered with the ITRA system, providing points and a ranking for finishers. Spectators can support runners at designated checkpoints, in accordance with the race rules.
course_highlights: A 50 km ultradistance through the beautiful natural surroundings of Taurkalne
Course registered with the ITRA system, with points and a ranking
Aid stations and four checkpoints where runners can receive support
additional: Participants receive a sweatband, a healthy post-finish meal (soup and cake), and aid stations along the sections between all four checkpoints. Spectators can support runners at checkpoints KP1, KP2, and KP4 with sports nutrition and encouragement, while equipment changes are allowed only at KP3. The course is partly accessible by car, and spectators have designated support rights along the course.

name: Valmieras skrējiens
description: The Valmiera Run is an annual running event in Valmiera, offering various distances, including a half marathon and 10 km races. The races take place on certified courses, ensuring accurate distance measurements and a high standard of competition. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, offering the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful urban setting. The Valmiera Run is part of the Latvian athletics calendar and attracts participants from across Latvia.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon and 10 km distances
The race takes place within the city of Valmiera
Precisely measured courses with an A-level certificate
additional: The courses are certified through 31.12.2027 with an A-level certificate issued by Arturs Onzuls. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized in accordance with LAA regulations.

description: Zilo kalnu Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. The event offers a range of distances for different ages and fitness levels, allowing participants to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail run. It welcomes both beginners and experienced runners, with awards for the top finishers in different age groups and distances. The Zilo kalnu event takes place in the city of Ogre and is part of a wider series of races held throughout Latvia.
course_highlights: A variety of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups and fitness levels
The event takes place in Ogre, amid beautiful natural scenery and challenging trail sections
additional: Late registration is available on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors, and special groups. Participant profiles are created and managed through the Stirnubuks.lv profile page.

name: We Run Riga pusmaratons Mežaparkā

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties visās pasākuma aktivitātēs un skrējienos, tai skaitā vairākās distancēs, ja pasākuma programma to ļauj, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties bērnu skrējienā un citās pasākuma aktivitātēs, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

description: The We Run Riga Half Marathon in Mežaparks is the biggest running festival of the autumn, taking place on 18 September in Mežaparks, Riga. The event offers a range of distances, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as children’s races. Participants receive an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other benefits. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, and participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.0975 km in Mežaparks
2 × 10.5 km relay
Races over various distances: 5 km, 10 km and children’s races
additional: Participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line. The entry fee includes an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other participant benefits.

name: Siguldas kalnu maratons (SKM)
organizer: Biedrība Kalnkāpēju sporta centrs sadarbībā ar IK Adventure Company
description: Sigulda Mountain Marathon (SKM) is Latvia’s hilliest trail race, held in the Sigulda area among steep hills and beautiful views of Gauja National Park. The event offers three distances: a full marathon of approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain, a 35 km half marathon, and a 10+ km mountain cross-country distance that is also suitable for walking. SKM tests both physical and psychological endurance, and the marathon distance is the Latvian Trail Running Championship. Participants receive unique finisher medals, and the course is regularly updated to keep it exciting and challenging.
course_highlights: The steep slalom slopes in the Sigulda hills have an elevation difference of up to 80 metres
The course includes Gauja National Park trails with stairs and impressive views
The full marathon distance is approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain and loss
additional: Participants completing the full marathon distance receive a unique finisher medal forged by blacksmith Jānis Banka. The 35 km and 70 km distances are worth ITRA points (2 and 3 points). The course is regularly adjusted and cleared to ensure the best conditions, taking into account natural conditions and storm damage. The 10+ km mountain cross-country distance is suitable for walking and is not intended for awards. The 2026 programme included approximately 70 km, 35 km, and a shorter distance. Participants in the longer races could earn ITRA points.

name: 62. Daugavpils skrējiens "Daugavpils-Mežciems"
description: The Daugavpils “Daugavpils-Mežciems” Run is a traditional event that promotes a healthy lifestyle and running as a mass-participation sport in Daugavpils and Latvia. The race takes place at Vienības Square in Daugavpils and offers several distances, including 10 km, a 5 km mass-participation run, and children’s races. The course is flat with slight inclines. The surface is mainly asphalt and paving stones, with a few short gravel sections. The event is open to all interested participants, subject to age restrictions, and offers race-bib collection on the day before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is one loop on asphalt and paving stones
The 5 km mass-participation run and Nordic walking follow one 5 km loop
The terrain is flat, with slight, gradual inclines
additional: Race-bib collection takes place on 25 September from 14:00 to 19:00 and on 26 September from 9:00 at the Daugavpils Tourist Information Centre (Rīgas iela 22). Registration is not available on race day. Participant results are processed by SIA “MANI APĻI”. Results are recorded for the 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women.

name: Skrējiens “Apkārt Lielezeram”
description: The “Around Lielezers” race is a traditional autumn sporting event in Limbaži, bringing runners together for the tenth time. The competition offers two distances—13.7 km and 6 km—with participants able to compete for course records and cash prizes. The event is popular with local and visiting athletes alike, offering exciting competition and a wonderful autumn atmosphere by Lielezers. The organizers give the fastest runners extra motivation with increased cash prizes and the chance to beat previous records.
course_highlights: Two distances—13.7 km and 6 km
A chance to set course records and cash prizes for the fastest runners
A race around scenic Lielezers in Limbaži
additional: The fastest man and woman overall in each distance receive a €100 prize. If course records are broken, an additional €100 or €200 is awarded. The event is organized by Limbaži Municipality. Contact details: Rīgas iela 16, Limbaži; phone +371 64023003 and +371 28398978. At the 2026 competition, cash prizes were planned for the fastest men and women in both distances.

name: Izskrien Ogri
organizer: Ogres novada sporta centrs sadarbībā ar Ogres novada pašvaldību un biedrību “Sporta klubs SportLat”

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Izskrien Ogre is an annual running event held in the Birch Avenue Square in Ogre, bringing together experienced runners, families with children, and active-lifestyle enthusiasts. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a children’s run of approximately 500 metres. The event is friendly and suitable for participants of various ages and fitness levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to enjoy running in an urban setting. It is organized by the Ogre Municipality Sports Centre in cooperation with Ogre Municipality and the “Sporta klubs SportLat” association.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Birch Avenue Square
5 km and 10 km routes through city streets and parks
A short children’s run of approximately 500 metres
additional: On race day, registration for the children’s runs is open from 9:00 to 10:30, while registration for the 5 km and 10 km distances is open until 11:30.

name: Kazdangas taku maratons
location: Atpūtas laukums pie Dzirnezera, Kazdanga, Latvia
description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail-running event held at the recreation area by Lake Dzirnezers in Kazdanga. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail marathon course, with professional RFID timing. The event is suitable for both experienced trail runners and those looking to test themselves in a natural setting. Traditionally, the race brings together athletes from various places, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A trail marathon course with varied terrain
Beautiful natural scenery by Lake Dzirnezers
Professional timing with RFID equipment

name: Dubultmaratons Taisnais Ērgļu stacijā
location: Sauriešu dzelzceļa stacija, Saurieši, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: Dubultmaratons Taisnais is an endurance race along the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line. The routes are marked and easy to follow, and can be completed by running, Nordic walking, or walking while enjoying Latvia’s beautiful natural scenery. The race offers three distances: double marathon (84.4 km), marathon (42.195 km), and half marathon (21.0975 km). It is organized by the Taisnais association in cooperation with the municipalities of Ogre and Madona. The start and finish are at railway stations. The race aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and identify Latvia’s most enduring long-distance runners and Nordic walkers.
course_highlights: The route follows the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line
A flat sandy path with no climbs, passing through dense forest, open areas, and over river bridges
The start and finish are at railway stations, and the course is clearly marked
additional: Participants must be at least 18 years old. Spectators may accompany participants on foot or by bicycle without disturbing others, but may not help them move along the course. Finish times differ for runners and Nordic walkers in each distance.

name: Lāčplēšu kross Rīgas Mežaparkā
description: Lāčplēšu Cross is a patriotic trail and obstacle race held in Riga’s Mežaparks. The event offers a range of distances for both children and adults, with participants following a marked course featuring natural and man-made obstacles. It brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels, including accomplished athletes, and fosters a sense of patriotism and unity through sporting activities. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish, and the fastest runners in the main distances receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Marked course through Mežaparks’ trails and meadows
Natural obstacles: sandy areas, roots and forest terrain
Man-made obstacles on various distances
additional: The event centre is located in the Great Meadow of Mežaparks. During the event, younger participants can take part in craft workshops, try archery and watch knight demonstrations. There are also interactive games about waste sorting and green living. An awards ceremony and a raffle with valuable prizes take place after the races. Participants can buy food and drinks at the event centre.

description: Stirnu buks is a popular trail running series held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The series aims to bring participants into nature, where they can improve their physical and mental well-being while enjoying scenic routes. The Grand Finale in Priekuļi is one of the series’ final and most anticipated events, bringing together trail runners from all over Latvia. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and also offers special distances for young people and children.
course_highlights: Routes and trails with varied surfaces — asphalt, gravel, forest roads and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups
The race takes place on scenic trails in Latvia’s forests
additional: Participants can register on the event website in the “Your profile” section. Last-minute registration is available on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course from 9:00 to 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups. Season passes are available at a discount, and the fee varies depending on the time of registration.

name: Latvijas čempionāts krosa skrējienā
description: The Latvian Cross Country Running Championships is a prestigious competition featuring athletes from various age groups, from youth to masters. The competition takes place over different distances and is a significant event in Latvia’s athletics calendar. The event brings together professional athletes and amateurs, offering a challenge and the opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles. Traditionally, the competition is held in October and is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association.
course_highlights: The competition features different distances for various age groups
Held on cross-country courses with varied surfaces and terrain
An opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles
additional: The competition includes the U12, U14, U16, U18 and U20 age groups, adults and masters. The event is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association. Previous competitions have been held in Carnikava, while the 2027 competition is planned for Daugavpils.

name: Ventspils novada Skriešanas seriāls "Ugāle" I posms

name: Fiz-Kul-Tūre
description: Fiz-Kul-Tūre is a running and Nordic walking series in Valmiera Municipality, held in several stages at different locations, including Valmiera and Rencēni. The autumn stages give participants the chance to enjoy running and Nordic walking in natural surroundings and a pleasant autumn atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and the best participants in the season’s overall standings are awarded at the end. Fiz-Kul-Tūre promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in Valmiera Municipality.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of Valmiera Municipality
Running and Nordic walking across multiple stages
Friendly atmosphere and awards for the season’s overall standings
additional: The Fiz-Kul-Tūre season finale takes place on a late autumn evening, ending on a positive note. Stages are held at different locations in Valmiera Municipality, such as Valmiera and Rencēni. Participants can take part in both running and Nordic walking.

name: Jāņa Daliņa piemiņas skrējiens un soļojums
Apkaimju brīvības skrējiens
description: The Neighborhood Freedom Run is a friendly, community-building run held in Atgāzene, Riga’s smallest neighborhood. The run covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns. Its aim is not competition, but a sense of community and support for Latvia’s freedom. The route is approximately 10.2 km long, and the pace is moderate, accommodating all participants. The event takes place on November 18, starting at 11:00, and includes several breaks for rest and water.
course_highlights: The route covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns
Three five-minute breaks with water and first aid available
Start and finish at the intersection of Atgāzenes iela and Vienības gatve
additional: The first 40 people to register and run will receive a commemorative gift from the organizers. Participants can leave warm clothing and bags in the organizers’ car at the start/finish area. The run aims to foster a sense of community and support for Latvia, not to compete for results. During the run, the organizers avoid having groups gather and adapt the pace to the slower participants.

name: Rembates aplis
description: “Rembates Circuit” is a running event in Rembate that brings together running enthusiasts for a shared competition. Participants can compete in various distances and age groups. The event offers an opportunity to test their abilities and enjoy the running atmosphere in Rembate.

name: Tautas skrējiens “Ieelpo Rēzekni”
description: The “Breathe in Rēzekne” public run is an annual running event held in Rēzekne, in the heart of Latgale, on November 18. The run brings together participants of different ages, encouraging an active lifestyle and a sense of community among the city’s residents. The event is part of the celebrations marking the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia and offers an opportunity to discover Rēzekne’s scenery and culture in a sporty atmosphere. The run is scheduled to start at 11:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: The run takes place within Rēzekne, offering beautiful city views
The event is part of the celebrations marking the 108th anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia
The run starts at 11:00, providing an opportunity for daytime activities
additional: The event takes place on November 18 from 11:00 to 14:00. No information about entry fees or registration is available. The run is a community event aimed at fostering a sense of belonging and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Latvijas kontūras skrējiens
location: Valmiera Town Hall Square (Valmieras rātslaukums), Valmiera, Latvia
description: The Latvian Contour Run in Valmiera is a traditional holiday run held on November 18 at Valmiera Town Hall Square. Participants can complete a 12.3 km route along streets named after notable figures and past popular attractions in Valmiera. The event also includes a holiday quiz with 12 checkpoints. Participants use the Qrenteerings mobile app to check in and enter a prize draw. The run is open to everyone, and finishing time is not important, so participants can complete the route at their convenience throughout the day.
course_highlights: A 12.3 km route along Valmiera streets named after notable figures
The route passes Valmiera Castle ruins, Vecpuiši Park, Valmiera Olympic Centre and the Music School
12 checkpoints with QR codes for quiz participants
additional: Participants can complete the route at any time that suits them throughout the day. To take part in the quiz, download the Qrenteerings app and use course code valmiera22. There are no traffic restrictions, and participants must obey traffic regulations. Participants are encouraged to attach a ribbon in the colors of the Latvian flag or another Latvian-themed decoration to their clothing. The route has 12 QR checkpoints, and the quiz in the Qrenteerings app is available from 9:00 to 21:00. Part of the route follows minor roads and paths that may be harder to navigate by bicycle or with a stroller. There are no traffic restrictions; participants must obey traffic regulations.
